Gorkasch StealthTimer PvMP Warg Stealth Level Tracker

What it does
As a Warg you know the problem: you pop Stealth or Disappear but you have no idea how much stealth level you have left. Is it safe to cross that open field or are you about to get spotted? This plugin gives you a live countdown of your remaining stealth level so you always know where you stand.

Gorkasch Plugins PvMP Creep Dashboard GP_CombatDash

A simple easytouse dashboard for combat vitals for Creeps. During a PvMP fight you want to know at a glance whether youre doing solid damage about to drop or whos healing you. item.title: CMapins (1.01)
item.description:
Version: 1.01
Author: Garan
Category: Creep Play
Updated: 2013-08-11 03:35 UTC
Downloads: 41,862
File: Cmapins_ver_1_01.zip (13.9 KB)

This is a very basic no frills window for activating your Creep maps. It can be positioned with the standard UI "Ctrl" command. It will autohide when not moused over and will also autohide for F12.

This plugin is compatible with LoTRO Plugin Compendium which is the easiest way to install/manage it.

To manually install download the zip and unzip it to your Plugin folder preserving the folder structure in the zip.

To load the plugin use "/plugins load CMapins"

When first loaded the mapin window will be in the center of your screen hover the mouse over the middle of your screen...

item.title: MonsterItems (1.1)
item.description:
Version: 1.1
Author: D.H1cks
Category: Creep Play
Updated: 2012-01-09 11:38 UTC
Downloads: 41,732
File: MonsterItems-1.1.zip (18.5 KB)

Monster Player Items Tracker

This plugin will track all the items required to turn in quests as a monster player. It is a tree view with the different quest categories and a total count.

Install
To install unzip the downloaded file into the C:UsersusernameDocumentsThe Lord of the Rings OnlinePlugins folder.

This plugin also requires the Turbine utilities file that is available at:

http://content.turbine.com/sites/lotro/lua/Beta_LuaPlugins.7z
